description: Invoke a specific named interaction on an object or Sim. Prerequisite: the target must appear in your lot's VM (use query-nearby / query-pie-menu to discover it), the interaction must appear in its pie-menu (server re-verifies via VMFindBestAction in VMNetInteractionCmd.Verify and rejects if param0 is not present), and your queue must have capacity (MAX_USER_ACTIONS = 8). Visitors/spectators are refused on every non-payphone object. Effect: the interaction is pushed onto your action queue; the engine runs it after the currently-running action completes — it plans a route, walks you to the target, runs the behaviour script, and applies motive effects. Cost: real seconds of session time while the interaction runs; motive deltas when it completes (e.g. Eat restores Hunger, Sleep restores Energy, Talk spends Social for both participants). queue_mode controls how the new interaction lands on your queue: 'queue' (default) cancels engine autopilot (Mode.Idle entries from spawn-objects and BHAV scripts) before enqueueing, so deliberate action outranks autopilot but your own existing queue is preserved; 'preempt' cancels the entire queue first.

args.name: interaction
args.description: TTAB index of the interaction, taken from query-pie-menu .interactions[].id.

args.name: callee_id
args.description: Object ID of the target (from nearby_objects[].object_id, nearby_sims[].object_id, or query-pie-menu .target_object_id). PersistID is NOT accepted — the VM addresses entities by ObjectID.

args.name: param0
args.description: Interaction variant parameter — some interactions expose subvariants via param0 (e.g. Chat Topics). Consult the pie-menu entry's param0 field.

args.name: global
args.description: Set to true if the interaction is exposed by the callee's GLOBAL TTAB rather than its own TTAB (rare; check the pie-menu entry's 'global' field).

args.name: queue_mode
args.description: How this interaction lands on your action queue. 'queue' (default) cancels engine autopilot (Mode.Idle entries from spawn-objects and BHAVs) before enqueueing — your deliberate interaction outranks autopilot but your existing self-queued actions are preserved. 'preempt' cancels everything currently in your queue and runs this immediately.

call_signatures: cf $CF interact-with --interaction <query-pie-menu.id> --callee_id <object_id>                   # run a named interaction (TTAB id from query-pie-menu)
cf $CF interact-with --interaction <id> --callee_id <id> --param0 <variant>                     # with subvariant (e.g. chat topics)
cf $CF interact-with --interaction <id> --callee_id <id> --global true                          # GLOBAL-TTAB interaction (check pie-menu entry's .global)
common_mistakes: callee_id is an ObjectID (from perception.nearby_objects[].object_id or query-pie-menu.target_object_id), NOT a persist_id.
Passing an interaction index from a DIFFERENT object's pie menu — indices are TTAB-slot-specific to that callee. Always query-pie-menu first on THIS target.
Expecting 'run now' from the default queue mode — 'queue' lands behind your existing self-queued actions (it only clears engine autopilot). For true 'run now', pass queue_mode='preempt'.
Setting --global true for a non-GLOBAL interaction — check the pie-menu entry's .global field first.
perception_hints: Your own action queue + UIDs (for cancel-interaction): perception.avatar.action_queue[].interaction_id

Each queue entry's .mode tells you what's there: 'normal' = deliberate (yours or another Sim's social), 'idle' = engine autopilot (spawn-object Idle, BHAV scripts). queue_mode='queue' clears 'idle' entries; queue_mode='preempt' clears all.
Dialog prompts (for respond-dialog): perception.recent_events[] where kind=='dialog', look at .extras.dialog_id
refuse_conditions: no live avatar → ok:false with 'no live avatar'
missing interaction (TTAB index) → ok:false with 'interact-with requires interaction (TTAB index)'
missing or zero callee_id → ok:false with 'interact-with requires callee_id'
queue_mode neither 'queue' nor 'preempt' → ok:false with 'queue_mode must be queue or preempt'
